@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+# NativeScript window factory authoring SDK correction
+
+The original concurrency and Shortcuts runs46000299446 and46000312643 reached passing builds/installation/App Group checks for both products, then stopped before UI execution at NativeScript surface validation. Their identical2686-byte original diagnostic is retained privately with SHA256 b96a7079000d51cbb9a455b87515c1a21ecc196db0b0a33d4d963e50b0ab9135. TS2307 reports the absent @hanlin/window-factory declaration package; six inferred-any diagnostics follow.
+
+The shipping native shared runtime already owns the exact @hanlin/window-factory package. This correction adds its four unchanged source/declaration/manifest files to SDK input provenance and stages that original package beside @hanlin/host-services. The authoring compiler recognizes the existing host-provided module, so prepared packages continue resolving the shared implementation instead of copying a second implementation. No runtime body, declaration, upstream dependency pin, fixture or assertion changes.
+
+Independent source review approved the exact two-file delta and native resource/dependency-copy contracts. Both JavaScript files passed the pinned Node24.5 syntax check. Actual SDK input enumeration changes392 to396: one existing staging-script digest changes; four original window-factory files enter the receipt; no prior source disappears or changes. This is a source qualification, not a new SDK producer/native result. The original complete producer, strict source validate/build, native tests and OS scenarios still require current-source results.
